use std::{fs,process::Command,time::{SystemTime,UNIX_EPOCH}};
fn scenario(script: &str) {
 let p=std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("direnv-contract-{}-{}",std::process::id(),SystemTime::now().duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH).unwrap().as_nanos()));
 fs::create_dir_all(p.join("project")).unwrap();fs::create_dir_all(p.join("outside")).unwrap();fs::create_dir_all(p.join("home")).unwrap();
 let r=Command::new("bash").args(["--noprofile","--norc","-ex","-c",script]).env_clear().env("PATH","/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin").env("HOME",p.join("home")).env("ROOT",&p).env("D",env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_direnv")).output().unwrap();
 let _=fs::remove_dir_all(&p);assert!(r.status.success(),"stdout={} stderr={}",String::from_utf8_lossy(&r.stdout),String::from_utf8_lossy(&r.stderr));
}
#[test]
fn enter_and_leave_restores_empty_unset_and_existing_values(){scenario(r#"
 export KEEP='before value' EMPTY=''; unset NEW
 cd "$ROOT/project"
 printf '%s\n' 'export KEEP="after value"' 'unset EMPTY' 'export NEW="new value"' > .envrc
 "$D" allow
 eval "$("$D" export bash)"
 test "$KEEP" = 'after value'; test "${EMPTY+x}" = ''; test "$NEW" = 'new value'
 cd "$ROOT/outside"; eval "$("$D" export bash)"
 test "$KEEP" = 'before value'; test "${EMPTY+x}" = x; test "$EMPTY" = ''; test "${NEW+x}" = ''
"#);}
#[test]
fn authorization_is_required_and_changes_revoke_it(){scenario(r#"
 cd "$ROOT/project"; unset GRANTED CHANGED
 printf '%s\n' 'export GRANTED=yes' > .envrc
 eval "$("$D" export bash || true)"; test "${GRANTED+x}" = ''
 "$D" allow; eval "$("$D" export bash)"; test "$GRANTED" = yes
 sleep 1.1 # direnv records file timestamps at whole-second granularity
 printf '%s\n' 'export CHANGED=yes' >> .envrc
 eval "$("$D" export bash || true)"; test "${CHANGED+x}" = ''
 "$D" allow; eval "$("$D" export bash)"; test "$CHANGED" = yes
 "$D" deny; cd "$ROOT/outside"; eval "$("$D" export bash || true)"
 cd "$ROOT/project"; eval "$("$D" export bash || true)"; test "${CHANGED+x}" = ''
"#);}
#[test]
fn parent_envrc_applies_to_descendants_and_preserves_quoted_values(){scenario(r#"
 cd "$ROOT/project"; mkdir -p child/deep
 printf '%s\n' "export COMPLEX='space ; dollar \$ quote \" text'" > .envrc
 "$D" allow; cd child/deep; eval "$("$D" export bash)"
 test "$COMPLEX" = 'space ; dollar $ quote " text'
 cd "$ROOT/outside"; eval "$("$D" export bash)"; test "${COMPLEX+x}" = ''
"#);}
